text.p: 3DO Co Thursday said it received 3.2 million shares of its own common stock from Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd in exchange for terminating certain rights originally granted to 3DO with respect to its M2 technology.
In 1995, 3DO licensed its next-generation, interactive M2 technology to Matsushita.

However, Matsushita has not yet announced any definitive plans to bring M2 products to market. Under the agreement, 3DO will relinquish its rights to develop and distribute software and peripherals that are compatible with M2 hardware products.

In addition, the company will give up its royalties with respect to Matsushita's potential use of the M2 technology, as well as certain other rights. In exchange, Matsushita has returned to 3DO all of the 3.2 million shares of 3DO stock that it previously owned, reprsenting an 11 percent stake in 3DO.
